About

Hi, I'm Ian.

I'm an AI Automation Specialist who builds workflows in Make, n8n, Zapier, and GoHighLevel. I focus on the tasks small businesses repeat every day: answering the same inquiries, copying data between tools, and chasing leads that went quiet. I use AI where it actually helps and plain logic where it doesn't, so what I build is dependable and inexpensive to run.

Before automation, I spent 8 years as a video editor. That work taught me to break big projects into small, precise steps, catch the details that are slightly off, and deliver on deadline for clients who just want the result to work. I bring the same habits to every build. I learn how a business actually runs, design the logic around it, and test the edge cases, like an invoice with no matching record or a call that comes in after hours, before anything goes live.

What I Do

Lead Qualification & Routing
New leads get sorted by intent and sent to the right person or follow-up sequence right away.
AI Customer Support
Assistants that answer from your own documents and pass tricky questions to a real person.
Document & Data Automation
Details from invoices and forms entered into your CRM or spreadsheet without retyping.
Custom Integrations
Small custom scripts, built with Claude Code, for jobs that drag-and-drop tools can't handle.
